item.title: Hida Folk Village: An Open-Air Museum of Traditional Mountain Houses — Guide
item.description: Hida Folk Village (Hida no Sato) is an open-air museum set on a hillside above Takayama, gathering more than 30 traditional houses relocated from across the mountainous Hida region, including steep gassho-zukuri farmhouses, and arranged around a central pond with mountain views. Visitors can enter many of the buildings to see the tools, hearths and layouts of old rural life, and craft demonstrations bring the traditional mountain culture to life, making it an accessible way to understand the region’s heritage in one place, especially useful alongside or instead of a trip to Shirakawa-go.
